svg.title: One hidden vector, two possible output heads
svg.desc: For the text Claim your free prize, GPT-2 produces a contextual vector at each position. At one position the original head reads 768 features to score vocabulary tokens. Its replacement reads those features to score ham and spam.

g.text: What changes when we replace the head?
“Claim your free prize!” → embeddings → 12 transformer blocks → final LayerNorm
Look at one token position: its hidden vector has 768 coordinates.
One score per possible next token
One score for ham, one for spam
